# Performance · caching

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-blocks.mjs from scripts/blocks-meta.json. Edit that file, not this one. -->

### Caching
- What: Keep the result of costly work so the next request can reuse it.
- Applies when: the same costly work is repeated often.
- Stage: with-users
- Kind: checkable

### Cache invalidation
- What: Remove or refresh cached data when the real data changes.
- Applies when: the app caches data that changes.
- Stage: with-users
- Kind: checkable

### Negative caching
- What: Remember that a lookup found nothing, so it is not repeated right away.
- Applies when: lookups that find nothing are repeated often.
- Stage: at-scale
- Kind: checkable

### Dynamic TTL
- What: Let each cached item expire at its own pace, depending on how fast it goes stale.
- Applies when: cached items go stale at different speeds.
- Stage: at-scale
- Kind: checkable

### HTTP caching & ETags
- What: Let browsers reuse a response they already have when it has not changed.
- Applies when: clients fetch the same responses repeatedly.
- Stage: at-scale
- Kind: checkable

### Semantic caching
- What: Reuse an AI answer when a new question means the same as an earlier one.
- Applies when: many users ask an AI model similar questions.
- Stage: at-scale
- Kind: checkable
